title: BAGMAN XeroSyncRun
description: One durable attempt to synchronise a `XeroConnection`'s reference data (`GET /Accounts`, CD-6 Slice 2, architect spec §4/§20). Exists specifically so a failed/partial sync can be recorded WITHOUT ever touching the last-known-good `XeroAccount` projection rows (architect spec §5/§20's 'a failed/partial sync must never replace last-known-good data with an empty or partial set') — the projection is only updated once a run reaches `SUCCEEDED`, inside one all-or-nothing transaction (see `services/xero/sync.py`).

sync_run_id.description: Canonical BAGMAN identifier for this sync attempt.

entity_id.description: The BAGMAN `GovernedEntity` (via its `XeroConnection`) this sync attempt was for.

tenant_id.description: The Xero tenant this attempt fetched from — a snapshot of the connection's `tenant_id` at the moment the run started, so this row remains meaningful even if the connection is later disconnected/reconnected to a different tenant.

status.description: This run's own closed, small state machine (mirrors `services.evidence.intake.intake`'s minimal shape): `RUNNING` (in flight) -> `SUCCEEDED` or `FAILED` (both terminal — a run is never retried in place; a retry creates a new `XeroSyncRun` row, exactly like `AIInvocation`'s own 'retries create new, auditable attempts' doctrine).

completed_at.description: UTC timestamp this attempt reached a terminal state. `null` while `status` is `RUNNING`.

accounts_seen_count.description: Total accounts returned by the provider in this attempt. `null` until known (e.g. still `RUNNING`, or `FAILED` before any page was fetched).

accounts_created_count.description: Of `accounts_seen_count`, how many were genuinely new `XeroAccount` rows this run created. `null` until known.

accounts_updated_count.description: Of `accounts_seen_count`, how many matched an existing `(tenant_id, account_id)` row and were updated in place. `null` until known.

error_code.description: A short, stable machine-readable failure classification (e.g. `TOKEN_REFRESH_FAILED`, `AUTH_REVOKED`, `RATE_LIMITED`, `PROVIDER_ERROR`, `MALFORMED_RESPONSE`, `PERSISTENCE_ERROR`) when `status` is `FAILED` — see `services/xero/sync.py::SyncFailureReason` for the closed set this is drawn from. `null` when `status` is not `FAILED`.

error_detail.description: Short, safe, NON-SECRET human-readable detail for `error_code`. Never a raw token/header/full provider response body.
